frontmatter.sidebar_description: Set a layout configuration for a zone.

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `setLayoutConfigurationWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow sets a layout configuration for a zone, either as the user's
personal configuration or as the system default. It also persists the saved
scope as the user's active view for the zone, so it sticks across reloads.

This workflow is used by the
[Set Layout Configuration Admin API Route](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#layouts\_postlayoutszoneconfiguration).

You can use this workflow within your own customizations or custom workflows,
allowing you to set a layout configuration within your custom flows.

steps.name: setLayoutConfigurationStep
steps.description:
This step sets a layout configuration for a zone, either as the user's
personal configuration or as the system default.

steps.name: setActiveLayoutScopeStep
steps.description:
This step sets a user's active layout scope for a zone, which determines
whether the user's personal or the system default configuration is shown.

children.name: SetLayoutConfigurationWorkflowInput
children.description: The data to set a layout configuration.

types.name: LayoutConfigurationDTO
types.description:
The layout configuration data model.

Unlike view configurations, there is at most one layout configuration per


`(zone, user_id)`

 pair, plus an optional single system default per zone.

children.name: zone
children.description: The zone (page) this configuration is for, e.g. "product.details".

children.name: user_id
children.description: The user ID this configuration belongs to, or null for the system default.

children.name: is_system_default
children.description: Whether this is the system default configuration for the zone.

children.name: widgets
children.description: Per-widget placement and visibility preferences, keyed by widget ID.

children.name: section
children.description: Override which section this widget appears in.

children.name: order
children.description: Override the sort order of the widget within its section.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the configuration was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the configuration was last updated.
